# NovoTech Machine Tools Inc.

> Metalworking and metal fabrication machinery supplier in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. Sells, installs and supports press brakes, laser cutters, shears, ironworkers, plate rollers, angle rolls, bandsaws, cold saws, rebar benders and cutters, pipe benders, hydraulic presses, bevelers, deburring and finishing machines, notchers and press brake tooling. Machines are supplied with CSA-approved electrical panels and supported with spare parts and technical support from Canada.

Contact: +1 647 526 5510 · info (at) NovoTechMachineTools.com · 1365 Mid-Way Blvd, Unit 26, Mississauga, ON L5T 2J5, Canada.
NovoTech is appointing independent sales agents and dealers in cities and provinces across Canada; enquiries through the quote form on any product page or by phone.
Social: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@NovoTechMachineTools · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/novotech-machine-tools-inc/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/novotechmachinetoolscanada · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/novotech_machinetools/
Brands represented include GMS GöçMakSan (rebar machinery), Dener (press brakes, shears, lasers), İşitan, Şahinler, Bekamak, Pilous, Gecam, CKEMSA, LFSS, Hidroliksan, Cevisa and EUROSTAMP tooling.

## Product pages

- [Rebar benders and rebar cutters (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-bender-and-cutter.html): every GMS rebar machine NovoTech supplies, with a single-bar capacity table for the whole range.
- [Rebar bending machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-bending-machines.html): stationary B and BS series benders (Ø1″–Ø2-3/8″ / 26–60 mm), portable MG and BT benders on 110/220 V, SL stirrup benders, SX and AXIS 50S spiral benders, dowel bar benders, the MAX 40 combined bender-cutter and HB/MH mesh machines — specification tables in inches and millimetres, photos and videos.
- [Rebar cutting machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-cutter.html): hydraulic H series (H 26–H 55), mechanical M series (M 36–M 55), double-acting SH 45 and SH 60, and the portable POWER 24 — cutting capacities for one or two bars at 45/65/85 kg/mm² steel.
- [Automatic rebar processing lines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/automatic-rebar-processing-lines.html): SLS 12 CNC stirrup bender from coil, MATRIX 55 / 55S shear lines, SYNCLONE 45S servo double bender — technical specifications, capacities and videos.
- [Metal cutting band saws (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/band-saw.html): horizontal band saws in two lines — premium Bekamak (Turkey) and NovoTech's own NovoFab Machinery value line — with a capacity table for every model, a band saw buying guide (sizes, pivot vs double column, blades, speeds and feeds, troubleshooting) and FAQs.
- [Manual band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/manual-band-saws.html): gravity-feed pivot saws — Bekamak BMS 230DG / 270DG double-miter and NovoFab NF-M 250 series and NF-M 400 (Ø10″–15-3/4″) — specs in inches and mm.
- [Semi-automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/semi-automatic-band-saws.html): hydraulic saws with automatic bow return — Bekamak BMSY DGH, G and straight-cut series (Ø9″–17-3/8″), NovoFab NF-H 250 S, NF-H 260 T, NF-H 330, NF-H 400, NF-H 300 SC and NF-H 460.
- [Automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/automatic-band-saws.html): NC / CNC saws that feed, clamp, cut and count — Bekamak BMSO roller-feed, E, GA, GS and DGS series; NovoFab NF-A 300, NF-A 300 SC, NF-A 330 and NF-A 350–600 CNC saws.
- [Double-column band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/double-column-band-saws.html): twin-column saws from Ø11″ to 59″ — Bekamak BMSY C / CGH / DG NC, BMSO C / CS / CGS / XS and heavy-duty series; NovoFab NF-DC 280 series, NF-DC 350 / 400 and NF-DC 500 / 600 gantry saws.
